annotations.title: Replace a page with new HTML

description: Re-imports ONE page (the home page too) from new HTML, in place: same address, same share link, same place in the page order, and a version is saved first so it can be undone. Use it to refresh a page built earlier. stage:true previews it before it goes live. Free.

draft_token.description: The draft token returned by draft_create, if you are working on an anonymous draft. Only needed when your client cannot send the x-pagetool-draft-token header.

html.description: The new full HTML for this page, imported exactly like create_site_from_html (the result includes the import report). The page keeps its address, its place in the page order and its version history; a version is saved first.

keep_added_sections.description: true = keep the sections added with add_section (reviews, map and the like) after the imported content, in their original order. Default false: the page is replaced and the result lists them in dropped_sections with a warning (an empty list means none were dropped).

path.description: The page to replace, e.g. "/about". "/" (the home page) is allowed. Defaults to "/".

site_key.description: The site the page belongs to. Defaults to the caller's current draft site when omitted.

stage.description: true = replace a staged copy instead of the live page: preview it at staged_preview_url, then publish_staged or discard_staged. Required with the operator token on a live site.
